versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No functionality changes; documentation file was deleted for streamlining.

- Initial release of the 网页内容提取工具 (Web Content Extraction Tool).
- Quickly extracts and converts web pages into clean Markdown, preserving links and structure.
- Requires user-provided API key for all operations; prompts user if missing.
- Supports extracting single or multiple (paginated) pages, with optional cookies file for authenticated access.
- Designed for use with AI agents, IDEs, and LLM pipelines.
